name: Lendlease Women in Civil Engineering Scholarship (UQ)
summary: One-year scholarship for domestic UQ civil engineering students partway through their degree.
who: Domestic student enrolled full-time in the BE(Hons), BE(Hons)/Master of Engineering, or an engineering dual.
Enrolled in any civil engineering discipline.
how: Apply using the UQ application portal with a cover letter, resume and mySI-net studies report.
catches: The name says it's for women, but the fetched eligibility list didn't state a gender rule. Check the page.
